blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The ecumenical network Philippine-Misereor Partnership Inc. (PMPI) has backed a call for the Marinduque provincial government to initiate a comprehensive ecological rehabilitation and restoration plan for communities and ecosystems damaged by decades of mining operations by Marcopper Mining Corp. In a statement issued on Thursday (Nov. 12), PMPI supported Resolution No. 09, Series of 2026, adopted by the Marinduque Council for Environmental Concerns (MACEC) on Nov. 2, which urged Gov. Melecio J. Go to convene the Rehabilitation, Remediation, and Oversight Committee to begin developing and implementing the long-delayed rehabilitation plan.
